title: A Differentiable Composite Approximation Framework for Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Maneuvering Modeling from Sea-Trial Data
abstract: arXiv:2606.19711v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Field-based modeling from onboard measurements can produce autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) maneuvering models that reflect real operating characteristics. From an approximation perspective, conventional maneuvering models use predefined constraint polynomial bases, whereas data-driven models use data-adaptive bases. Motivated by this basis-function view, this paper presents a differentiable composite approximation formulation, in which the polynomial basis component and the data-adaptive basis component are treated as differentiable parts of a unified predictor and calibrated jointly. A gradient-based co-calibration method is developed for full-scale AUV maneuvering prediction, where a sensitivity-aware mechanism regulates bounded polynomial updates while the neural residual captures remaining nonlinear discrepancies under a shared prediction objective. translated_title: 基于海试数据的自主水下航行器机动建模可微复合近似框架
translated_abstract: 基于船上测量数据的实航建模能够产生反映真实运行特性的自主水下航行器（AUV）机动模型。从近似的角度来看，传统机动模型采用预定义的约束多项式基，而数据驱动模型采用数据自适应基。受这一基函数视角的启发，本文提出了一种可微复合近似形式，将多项式基分量和数据自适应基分量视为统一预测器中的可微部分并进行联合校准。针对全尺度AUV机动预测，本文开发了一种基于梯度的协同校准方法，其中灵敏度感知机制调节有界多项式更新，而神经残差在共享预测目标下捕获剩余的非线性差异。为了考虑实测数据中海流的影响，一种基于回转运动的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种可微复合近似框架，将多项式基与数据自适应神经基作为统一预测器的可微分量进行梯度联合校准，从而从海试数据中建立更准确的AUV机动模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a differentiable composite approximation framework that jointly calibrates polynomial bases and data-adaptive neural bases as differentiable components of a unified predictor via gradient-based co-calibration, enabling more accurate AUV maneuvering models from sea-trial data.
